name: Sárkeresztúr (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sárkeresztúr: a white shield with a stork, reeds and a bridge, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and yellow mantling, above a scroll inscribed SÁRKERESZTÚR.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Sárkeresztúr arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
